nss.name: National Service Scheme (NSS)
nss.aim: To create social awareness among students through community engagement.
activities: Assisting police authorities during Ganesh festival
Educating people in neighbouring rural areas
nss.benefit: Students who satisfactorily complete 120 hours of NSS work are eligible to receive 10 grace marks in college / university examination.

student_council.name: Students' Council
student_council.role: Organizes all cultural programmes in the college under the 'Talent Search Parade'. Functions according to University statutes.
student_council.selection_policy: Selection of students will be on their academic excellence. There is no place for election as per University & Govt. of Maharashtra rules.
composition: 2. One Lecturer nominated by the Principal
4. One student from each class who has shown academic merit in the preceding year and is engaged in full-time students' activities (nominated by Principal)
5. One student each with outstanding performance in Sports, N.S.S., and Cultural Activities
6. Two lady students nominated by the Principal
7. Secretary of the Council (selected by the student council members from amongst themselves)

gymkhana.name: College Gymkhana & Sports
gymkhana.facilities: Well-developed outdoor grounds and modern gymnasium apparatus with fitness workout machines for health and sports development.

canteen.name: College Canteen
canteen.features: Hygiene and quality food items at reasonable student-friendly rates, accessible during recess.

job_melas.name: Job Melas & Campus Placements
job_melas.features: Tie-ups with leading corporate firms for on-campus interviews and Job Melas. Regular soft skill training and personality grooming sessions to prepare students for career success.

cultural_and_fests.history: Organized annually since 2009 as an intra-collegiate cultural festival.
annual_celebrations: Birthdays of Eminent Indian Personalities & Leaders

magazine.name: College Magazine Cum Calendar
magazine.description: Annual publication showcasing creative writing, poems, essays, artistic achievements, and college milestones, entirely compiled and designed by Vande Mataram family members.

social_work.requirement: Compulsory 30 hours of social work for all enrolled students.
social_work.document: Every student signs an MOU undertaking attached to the college booklet at admission.

open_ncc.name: Open National Cadet Corps (NCC)
open_ncc.policy: Students are given official permission and rights to join open N.C.C. training battalions conducted by outside colleges.

distinctive_features.alumni_association: Registered Alumni Association (Registration No. MAH/1326/2018/THANE) conducting regular reunions and mentorship sessions with juniors.
distinctive_features.parent_teacher_meet: Periodic PTM meetings to review academic growth, attendance, and student conduct with concerned teachers.
distinctive_features.excursions: Excursions at prime locations twice a year for Life Science students, plus annual industrial visits and study tours for all faculties.
distinctive_features.workshops_and_seminars: Conducted on Personality Development, Stress Management, Time Management, and Emerging Technologies.
distinctive_features.guest_lectures: Eminent scholars and industry experts invited to update students with recent technological and academic advancements.

national_and_international_days.day: World Vegetarian Day / International Day of Older/Elderly
Global Hand-wash Day & International Day of Rural Women
National Girl Child Day of India
JMF Vegan Life Pledge Day / Gurukul Day
